decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the use commences.

Condition : 3 - 3-	The site shall only be used as a (sui generis) waste transfer station for non putrescent materials and not for any other use defined or not defined by the Town & Country Planning (Use Class) Order 1987

Condition : 4 - 4-	The use hereby permitted shall be for a temporary period of up to 3 years from the date of this permission, after which time the use shall cease and the land returned to a condition deemed acceptable by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - 5-	Details of the proposed parking, loading and turning spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and be constructed and laid out for use before the commencement of the use or occupation of any part of the building for (sui generis) waste transfer use hereby permitted and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 6 - 6-	Details of the proposed dust suppression sprinkler system shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and be constructed and laid out for use before the commencement of the use or occupation of any part of the building for (sui generis) waste transfer use hereby permitted.

Condition : 7 - 7-	Details of the proposed wheelwashing facilities for all commercial vehicles visiting the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and be constructed and laid out for use before the commencement of the use or occupation of any part of the building for (sui generis) waste transfer use hereby permitted.

Condition : 8 - The main entrance doorways in these units shall each have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the parking bays, the pavement and the ground floor and door handles not exceeding 1m above ground level.

Condition : 9 - It is considered that this application for the variation of condition four, enabling the implementation of the previous temporary permission, would not have an adverse affect upon the regeneration of the site identified within the Brentford Area Action Plan, highway safety or the amenities of the area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses) and ENV.P.2.3 (Waste Management Facilities) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Variation of Condition 4 (3 year time limit) to extend time of planning permission 00703/A9/P5 dated 16/11/2001
